Source Monster

Monster: Volvidon | CR: 5 | Tier: 2

Compatible Slots: Armor, Weapon

Weapon Effect

Your weapon deals an extra [[/r 1d4]] slashing damage.

Armor Effect

While you are wearing this armor, you can use your reaction or bonus action to gain resistance to slashing damage until the end of your next turn. Once you use this property, you cannot use it again until you finish a long rest.

Tags: mechanic:extra-damage:minor, type:offensive, damage:slashing, mechanic:reaction, mechanic:bonus-action, mechanic:resistance, mechanic:long-rest, type:defensive
